response.overview: At the gym, Sing is ignoring haunting visions of a dripping white shirt by pushing her body to breaking point. Under the guise of a night out, her concerned friends stage an intervention but in denial she rejects their help. Triggered and trying to escape, Sing is again confronted by the vision and a touch on her arm sends her into a violent frenzy attacking an innocent man in the back of the bar. Realising what she’s done, the incident becomes a conflicting wake up call to listen to her body and confront the traumatic energy that lives inside.
response.title: Beast Mode
